import numpy as np, requests, json, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
D='/tmp/acc'; os.makedirs(D,exist_ok=True)
for a in ['Q3UX83','Q4AC99','Q96QU6']:
    j=S.get(f'https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}',timeout=120).json()[0]
    open(f'{D}/AF-{a}.pdb','w').write(S.get(j['pdbUrl'],timeout=180).text)
open(f'{D}/1M7Y.pdb','w').write(S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1M7Y.pdb',timeout=120).text)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_pdb(path, chain=None):
    ca=[];het=[];allat=[];seen=set()
    for l in open(path):
        rec=l[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM'): continue
        if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        if l[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        ch=l[21];resn=l[17:20].strip();resi=l[22:27].strip();name=l[12:16].strip()
        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        b=float(l[60:66]) if l[60:66].strip() else 0.0
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' or resn=='MSE':
            allat.append([ch,resi,resn,name,xyz,b])
            if name=='CA' and resn in AA3 and (ch,resi) not in seen:
                seen.add((ch,resi)); ca.append([ch,resi,resn,xyz,b])
        else: het.append([ch,resi,resn,name,xyz])
    return ca,het,allat
def seq_of(ca): return ''.join(AA3.get(r[2],'X') for r in ca)
B="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B.strip().split('\n');hd=ls[0].split();M62={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for b,v in zip(hd,p[1:]): M62[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(hd)};SM=np.full((21,21),-2.0)
for (a,b),v in M62.items(): SM[idx[a],idx[b]]=v
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s])
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2);n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0;Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);pX[1:,0]=1;Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);pY[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        srow=SM[e1[i-1],e2];Mp=Mm[i-1];Xp=Ix[i-1];Yp=Iy[i-1]
        A1=np.vstack([Mp[:-1],Xp[:-1],Yp[:-1]]);Mm[i,1:]=A1.max(0)+srow;pM[i,1:]=A1.argmax(0)
        A2=np.vstack([Mp[1:]+go,Xp[1:]+ge,Yp[1:]+go]);Ix[i,1:]=A2.max(0);pX[i,1:]=A2.argmax(0)
        Mi=Mm[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i];Pi=pY[i]
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            a=Mi[jj-1]+go;b=Xi[jj-1]+go;c=Yi[jj-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Yi[jj]=a;Pi[jj]=0
            elif b>=c: Yi[jj]=b;Pi[jj]=1
            else: Yi[jj]=c;Pi[jj]=2
    i,jj=n,m;stt=int(np.argmax((Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));pr=[]
    while i>0 and jj>0:
        if stt==0: pr.append((i-1,jj-1));stt=pM[i,jj];i-=1;jj-=1
        elif stt==1: stt=pX[i,jj];i-=1
        else: stt=pY[i,jj];jj-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,s,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    return Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T, qc-(Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T)@pc
def dp(Dm,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=Dm.shape;F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    F[1:,0]=np.arange(1,n+1)*gap;P[1:,0]=1;F[0,1:]=np.arange(1,m+1)*gap;P[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Fi=F[i];Fp=F[i-1];Di=Dm[i-1]
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            a=Fp[jj-1]+Di[jj-1];b=Fp[jj]+gap;c=Fi[jj-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: Fi[jj]=a;P[i,jj]=0
            elif b>=c: Fi[jj]=b;P[i,jj]=1
            else: Fi[jj]=c;P[i,jj]=2
    i,jj=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 and jj>0:
        p=P[i,jj]
        if p==0: pr.append((i-1,jj-1));i-=1;jj-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: jj-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def salign(A,Bc,seed,it=8):
    L=min(len(A),len(Bc));d0=1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8;pairs=seed;best=None
    for _ in range(it):
        P=np.array([A[i] for i,j2 in pairs]);Q=np.array([Bc[j2] for i,j2 in pairs])
        R,t=kabsch(P,Q);At=A@R.T+t
        d=np.linalg.norm(At[:,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:],axis=2);Ds=1/(1+(d/d0)**2)
        np_=dp(Ds);tm=sum(Ds[i,j2] for i,j2 in np_)/L
        core=[(i,j2) for i,j2 in np_ if d[i,j2]<5];rms=float(np.sqrt(np.mean([d[i,j2]**2 for i,j2 in core])))
        if best is None or tm>best[0]: best=(tm,R.copy(),t.copy(),list(np_),len(core),rms)
        if np_==pairs: break
        pairs=np_
    return best

stv={}
for k,(p,ch) in {'Mouse Accsl':(f'{D}/AF-Q3UX83.pdb',None),'Human ACCSL':(f'{D}/AF-Q4AC99.pdb',None),
                 'Human ACCS':(f'{D}/AF-Q96QU6.pdb',None),'avg':(f'{D}/1M7Y.pdb','A')}.items():
    ca,het,allat=parse_pdb(p,ch)
    stv[k]={'seq':seq_of(ca),'coords':np.array([r[3] for r in ca]),'resi':[r[1] for r in ca],
            'resn':[r[2] for r in ca],'plddt':[r[4] for r in ca],'het':het,'all':allat}
lig=np.array([h[4] for h in stv['avg']['het'] if h[2]=='PPG'])
byres={}
for ch,resi,resn,name,xyz,b in stv['avg']['all']: byres.setdefault((resi,resn),[]).append(xyz)
pocket=[]
for i,(resi,resn) in enumerate(zip(stv['avg']['resi'],stv['avg']['resn'])):
    at=np.array(byres[(resi,resn)])
    d=float(np.linalg.norm(at[:,None,:]-lig[None,:,:],axis=2).min())
    if d<=4.5: pocket.append((i,resi,resn,d))
labels=[f"{AA3[p[2]]}{p[1]}" for p in pocket]
cols={}; dists={}; tms={}
for q in ['Mouse Accsl','Human ACCSL','Human ACCS']:
    seed=nw(stv[q]['seq'],stv['avg']['seq'])
    tm,R,tv,pairs,nc,rms=salign(stv[q]['coords'],stv['avg']['coords'],seed)
    tms[q]=(tm,rms,nc)
    r2q={b2:a2 for a2,b2 in pairs}
    qat=[[a[1],a[2],a[3],a[4]@R.T+tv,a[5]] for a in stv[q]['all']]
    qby={}
    for resi,resn,name,xyz,b in qat: qby.setdefault((resi,resn),[]).append(xyz)
    cc=[];dd=[]
    for i,resi,resn,d in pocket:
        qi=r2q.get(i)
        if qi is None: cc.append('-');dd.append(np.nan);continue
        qresi=stv[q]['resi'][qi];qresn=stv[q]['resn'][qi]
        cc.append(f"{AA3.get(qresn,'X')}{qresi}")
        at=np.array(qby[(qresi,qresn)])
        dd.append(float(np.linalg.norm(at[:,None,:]-lig[None,:,:],axis=2).min()))
    cols[q]=cc;dists[q]=dd
print({k:(round(v[0],3),round(v[1],2),v[2]) for k,v in tms.items()})

ax.set_xticks([0,1,2,3]); ax.set_xticklabels(['Apple ACS\n(1M7Y, AVG site)']+qs,fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.xaxis.set_ticks_position('top')
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_title('Structural equivalents of the apple ACC synthase substrate pocket\n(green identical, amber conservative, red different)',
             fontsize=11,pad=38)

w=0.26
for c,q in enumerate(qs):
